field.label: Enabled
field.help: Run the Layer 7 engine. Traffic is classified and stored; policies are enforced if enforcement is on.

field.label: Monitored interfaces
field.help: Capture on these interfaces. Choose the LAN (client side) interfaces so client addresses are visible before NAT. VLAN interfaces can be selected individually.

field.label: Enforce blocking
field.help: When off, block policies only log what they would block.

field.label: Retention (days)
field.help: Flows and events older than this are deleted.

field.label: Flow idle timeout (s)
field.help: An idle flow is closed and stored after this many seconds.

field.label: Block lifetime (s)
field.help: How long a blocked destination address stays in the pf table before it expires.
